mentions.name: unreal-talk (a Dynamicland re-implementation)
mentions.description: A personal re-implementation of Dynamicland. It enables live-editing of the behaviour of the editor script, with the source available in a public repository and a browser-based live version that can be tried directly.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on my version of Dynamicland. Today I got this small thing working where I can now live-edit the behaviour of the editor script
